title: Cosmic Time: Ages, Wars, and Salvations
summary: The temporal arc of redemption articulated in three frames: the Three Cosmic Ages from the First Man's descent through the building of the cosmos to the dissolution at Panaretos's ascent; the Four Wars of the Sons of Light against the Sons of Darkness; and the Four (or Five) Successive Salvations by which the Lord progressively releases captive light. These three frames give the same drama as time, as conflict, and as deliverance.
organizing_principle: Sequential temporal articulation of the cosmic drama through three discrete frames (ages, wars, salvations), each enumerating the discrete operations of regeneration in time.
